crown: No body moves outward by name or version alone. Source, finding, audit, current-best decision, crown scope and living route must all pass.
promotion_rules: Every promoted public record must have an ID, house, name/current label, evidence, bounded status and next action.
Every public route must be absolute HTTPS and must not contain embedded credentials or fragments.
A higher version number never crowns itself.
Public projection may not expose owner notes, local custody paths, private source paths or personal-contact fields.
The six-stage passport governs the public-contract entry; it does not silently claim universal source supremacy.
New bodies or Project Heads must update the expected count deliberately rather than slipping past the gate.
boundary: This gate governs the 61-body, 11-Project-Head Estate Head public contract and its connected classification/Stringline sources. It is repository-wide promotion enforcement for the current public authority, not a claim that every historical private ZIP, chat export or Library file has completed the wider byte-for-byte census.
